scope: Historical raw coordinates; same fixed B defines success. Request-equal metrics; unique hits deduplicated within each request across inference seeds. Off pool reused across goals, not independent new proposals. Training novelty references include declared source and per-arm rollout/critic fitting assets; foundation pretraining overlap unknown.

input_contract.padding: group by canonical per-molecule padded length, matching train/inference

predictor.role: Same fixed B defines training labels, rewards and success; not independent DFT truth

BRICS.scope: Existing 192 unconditional BRICS attempts; each original conformer evaluated once. Goal rescoring does not add proposals. Different fragment/size prior from octree. No force or DFT gate.

source_retrieval.scope: Cached fixed-B source library lookup, no new proposals; zero source-novel structures. B labelling cost is recorded separately. Targets come only from source B distribution.

replay_validation.scope: Implementation replay only, not new independent proposals. Same frozen SFT, seed2111/P25, batch8 and FP32. No DPA or DFT calls. Original NPZ also stores tokens; replay token SHA matches each original token array.
